t: 克罗地亚贵族在克丁1527年的选举中选举斐迪南一世为克罗地亚国王.
te: Croatian nobles elect Ferdinand I, Archduke of Austria as King of Croatia in the 1527 election in Cetin.
dz: 克罗地亚贵族在克丁1527年的选举中选举斐迪南一世为克罗地亚国王.
de: Croatian nobles elect Ferdinand I, Archduke of Austria as King of Croatia in the 1527 election in Cetin.

t: 将斐迪南一世加冕为布拉格的波希米亚国王.
te: Coronation of Ferdinand I as the king of Bohemia in Prague.
dz: 将斐迪南一世加冕为布拉格的波希米亚国王.
de: Coronation of Ferdinand I as the king of Bohemia in Prague.

t: 西班牙和德军打包罗马;许多学者认为这是文艺复兴的终结.
te: Spanish and German troops sack Rome; many scholars consider this the end of the Renaissance.
dz: 西班牙和德军打包罗马;许多学者认为这是文艺复兴的终结.
de: Spanish and German troops sack Rome; many scholars consider this the end of the Renaissance.

t: 佛罗伦萨人第二次将美第奇人赶出去,佛罗伦萨重新成为一个共和国.
te: The Florentines drive out the Medici for a second time and Florence re-establishes itself as a republic.
dz: 佛罗伦萨人第二次将美第奇人赶出去,佛罗伦萨重新成为一个共和国.
de: The Florentines drive out the Medici for a second time and Florence re-establishes itself as a republic.

t: 潘菲洛·德·纳尔瓦埃斯 (Pánfilo de Narváez) 与 600 名男子离开西班牙…
te: Pánfilo de Narváez departs Spain to explore Florida with 600 men – by 1536 only four survive.
dz: 潘菲洛·德·纳尔瓦埃斯 (Pánfilo de Narváez) 与 600 名男子离开西班牙，前往探索佛罗里达州 — 到 1536 年，只剩下四人幸存。
de: Pánfilo de Narváez departs Spain to explore Florida with 600 men – by 1536 only four survive.

t: 法塔赫将葡萄牙军队从现在被视为雅加达基础的Sunda Kelapa驱逐出.
te: Fatahillah expels Portuguese forces from Sunda Kelapa, now regarded as the foundation of Jakarta.
dz: 法塔赫将葡萄牙军队从现在被视为雅加达基础的Sunda Kelapa驱逐出.
de: Fatahillah expels Portuguese forces from Sunda Kelapa, now regarded as the foundation of Jakarta.

t: Lê Cung Hoàng 将王位让给 Mạc Đăng Dung，结束了 Lê 王朝并开始了…
te: Lê Cung Hoàng cedes the throne to Mạc Đăng Dung, ending the Lê dynasty and starting the Mạc dynasty.
dz: Lê Cung Hoàng 将王位让给 Mạc Đăng Dung，结束了 Lê 王朝并开始了 Mac 王朝。
de: Lê Cung Hoàng cedes the throne to Mạc Đăng Dung, ending the Lê dynasty and starting the Mạc dynasty.

t: 北美最早已知的信由约翰·拉特(John Rut)在纽芬兰岛圣约翰(St. John's)寄出.
te: The first known letter from North America is sent by John Rut while at St. John's, Newfoundland.
dz: 北美最早已知的信由约翰·拉特(John Rut)在纽芬兰岛圣约翰(St. John's)寄出.
de: The first known letter from North America is sent by John Rut while at St. John's, Newfoundland.
